sectionDescription: Configure WeCom group bot Webhook to receive system notifications
fieldEnabledDesc: When enabled, the system will send notifications via WeCom group bot
fieldWebhookUrlDesc: Webhook URL of WeCom group bot
toastTestSuccess: Test message sent successfully. Please check your WeCom group.
howToTitle: How to configure WeCom group bot:
step1Item1: Open WeCom group → “...” in top-right → Group bot
step2Item1: After creation, WeCom will generate a Webhook URL
step2Item3: Fill URL into the config above
step3Item1: Make sure the bot can send messages
step3Item2: Optionally limit bot usage scope and rate
featuresItem1: Supports text, markdown, image, file and more message types
featuresItem2: Each bot can send up to 20 messages per minute
